body:
Map deposits are currently tied to the engine's fixed inventory slots. This refactor separates configurable map resources from twelve fixed materials, so a catalog can add a deposit, combine yields, or change growth, harvesting and obstruction without adding resource-specific simulation branches.

## Result

- Map-owned immutable resource catalogs provide stable keys, deterministic IDs, validated imports, embedded save definitions, and compact compiled property tables. Single-material stock stays inline; mixed stocks use packed map-owned storage.
- Workers request and carry materials. Buildings, supply routing, gradients, statistics and every AI use material semantics; source queries evaluate the actual resource properties. Absent materials avoid natural-resource gradient allocation and work, while stored supplier stock remains deliverable.
- Growth, spreading, habitat, depletion, farm reserves, clearing, movement, visibility and presentation are declarative. Sprite levels use total stock; deterministic variants do not consume simulation randomness. Missing artwork has a visible fallback.
- Editors, scripts, experiments, UI and documentation distinguish deposits from owned materials. Gold ore/gold, iron ore/metal, sand/glass and cotton/fabric include AI-generated artwork and engine support; existing recipes and default distributions do not use them.
- Legacy saves remain loadable with the save floor unchanged. Current saves embed authoritative definitions and stock. Replay/network compatibility deliberately advances (save format 140, protocol 59, simulation revision 24).

## Behavioral changes

The three intended fixes stop maximum-stock oscillation, reject harvest completion after the requested stock vanishes, and prevent depleted fruit from remaining a harvesting target. Custom-resource tests additionally cover mixed yields, destructive harvesting, infinite stocks, passability combinations and sustainable pooled farms. Existing gameplay pacing and economy are under paired comparison; statistical similarity is not yet established.

## Verification and accepted follow-up

The production engine checkpoint is `b3fab1a48`; final fixture, translation and test-reporting repairs extend it through `f264a6a07`. Integrated master is `e53a673b2`. These final repairs do not change production simulation code.

- Native: four affected targets build; prior broad validation covered1,911cases (1,763passed,148skipped), with subsequent focused AI/resource/continuation checks and inspected UI captures. Final stock and official-match checksum traces remain unchanged.
- Android x86-64:36unit and98engine cases passed. Stock, official-match and150-row resource-composition traces match native exactly. Source/payload hashes remained stable; emulator andADB were stopped. [Final Android evidence](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/78dd865/android-b3fab-checkpoint).
- Windows andGCC11 shared JavaScript coverage:25unit plus57engine cases passed, and the production CLI continuation passed. The frozen JavaScript checker had selected obsolete terrain-era hashes; it now selects the already-committed resource traces. Both profiles pass serial/four-worker execution and all six saved continuations. Actual Windows/GCC11 traces match native.
- Legacy telemetry: all four resource-era full-byte traces pass serial and parallel verification (5,376ticks per mode). Their entity changes are bracketed to the earlier SIM23 recovery-policy update; all four match the final engine's entity records. Old saves and historical traces remain preserved. Maxima's legacy fixture also passes512full tick hashes and256resumed records in both modes against its separately retained resource-era reference.
- Generator validation:544current Linux golden rows pass locally and match independently observedGCC11/GCC13 outputs. All1,108historical rows are archived. Resource epoch1 deliberately removes sprite draws from simulation RNG. Current macOS full generator hashes are explicitly unverified; actual portable topology checks remain enforced. A reporting-only fix prevents these disclosed omissions from becoming false JUnit failures.
- Translation audit: all32 non-English catalogs translated for the new labels;5/5tests pass and catalog audit reports0structural errors. Narrow genuine cognates are explicitly reviewed; the checker is unchanged.
- Final paired gameplay campaign:42candidate simulations completed with0integrity/parse failures. Against the approved-fix control, all12 jointly resolved primary pairs retained their winners. Across40primary pairs/eight geometry clusters, new buildings Δ+0.4 (95%CI−0.575to1.8), starvationΔ+0.45 (−3.85to6.475), and Food delivery/1,000ticksΔ+0.636 (−0.0747to1.4809). Limited seeds and substantial censoring prevent an equivalence claim. Post-run analysis interruption was recovered from verified original records without rerunning games.

**The maintainer explicitly waived performance as a merge blocker and requested merge to unblock dependent work.** The2%aggregate/5%individual CPU acceptance gates have not been established. Earlier failed/inconclusive measurements remain retained, and the final candidate has not completed a fresh full CPU corpus. No performance-governor campaign was launched; performance optimization and the full timing/stress campaign remain follow-up work. Instruction reductions are diagnostic evidence only.

[Native/platform/cache checkpoint evidence](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/32bbac1/native-b3fab-checkpoint) preserves exact inputs, commands, logs, checksums, screenshots, initial failures and repairs. [Aligned approved-fix control](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/963b0fe/f0-approved-fixes-control) preserves all84control runs. Final tournament and repair evidence is being published separately.

Hosted final coverage is still completing; macOS had842engine passes,132skips and the corrected reporting-only failure. Physical ARM/iOS execution and maintainer gameplay review remain unverified. No full hosted all-green or final performance-equivalence claim is made.

Published the completed query-cache checkpoint evidence at [e1bc39195675dcd05c1f6874f2b3fc596afce9df](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/e1bc39195675dcd05c1f6874f2b3fc596afce9df): [test artifacts](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/e1bc39195675dcd05c1f6874f2b3fc596afce9df/native-query-641-cases.zip), [build logs, traces, calibration and profiling](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/e1bc39195675dcd05c1f6874f2b3fc596afce9df/native-query-641-diagnostics.zip), and [scope/provenance summary](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/e1bc39195675dcd05c1f6874f2b3fc596afce9df/native-query-641-summary.json). Extract both ZIPs into one directory; the shared inventory hashes every member.

The focused run has 317 JUnit cases: 316 passed, one display case deliberately skipped, no failures/errors. Tested source is the exact change committed as `641dca365` on `f0ff8384b`; the tests ran before commit with checkout HEAD `72fdb68c8` plus the exact tested patch; this is checkout provenance, not a verified embedded Git label. The clean build at `641dca365` and stock/match traces are separately included. Environment is Linux x86_64, GCC 15.2, release/O3, optimized_assets=0, the retained patched SDL/runtime dependencies; exact commands, library identities, XML and logs are in the bundles and earlier SDL reproduction package.

The first cache pass preserved initial/final checksums, full team histories and job counts over 7,680 ticks, and reduced instructions by 9.1%. Profiling included startup/concurrent workloads and is diagnostic only. Historical `41384` quiet single-case rows are preserved, including their noise and approved-control regression; they are not a `641dca365` performance verdict.

Production has since advanced to `da80dbaac` with a second reviewed query pass and material-delivery naming cleanup. Its final broad native checks and aligned corpus preflight are separate ongoing work; this evidence does not establish that later revision's complete acceptance. Final platform refresh, candidate tournaments, quiet CPU gates and maintainer gameplay review remain pending. PR stays draft.

Current native checkpoint evidence is published at [04700262](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/04700262ddc3f16cb937890ac0626ef9faad028e). PR remains draft: the CPU gate is blocked.

Tested production revision `da80dbaac80284db77c5ee6e1de64ac6c772fe00`; current source `4ca3b6eb63bd6b71055ba238be9fd33de15da79d` merges only the upstream browser fixture update and its format-140 replacement. Clean current CLI is byte-identical to da80, SHA256 `6233113cc96911197f7c44248dc225499248efa8cf590ea998fa61189b99a68a`. Source base is `e53a673b2`; pure/approved control production base is `f0ff8384b` (the intervening upstream change is browser-fixture-only).

- Broad native: 1,911 cases, **1,763 passed, 148 skipped, zero failures/errors**. Focused prepared-query: **361 passed, one intentional display skip**. Display: **9/9 passed**, including editor material rows, building material visibility and FarmAreas; raw screenshots retained and inspected.
- Current stock trace `5570a99e…`; SIM24 match trace `c02adc67…`. Complete hashes, commands, fixtures and outputs are in the bundles.
- Quiet full-corpus timing stopped after the second completed eight-pair case failed: `land-2-1001-maxima-middle` simulation CPU ratio **1.185884**, 95% interval **[1.176691, 1.195702]**. The first early case was near baseline. All rows, including the subsequent partial scenario, are retained. Final input audit found no changed input. There is **no full-corpus aggregate** and no performance acceptance.
- Independent review found low within-arm variance and consistent order/half/influence checks. Matched three-arm diagnosis shows the approved-fixes control reproduces the candidate's terminal teams/history/statistics and work counts. Candidate instructions are essentially equal to that control, while both have more placement work than pure baseline. The approved fixes do not waive the requested 5% case / 2% aggregate limits. A narrow traversal optimization is now being validated.

Environment: Linux x86_64, GCC 15.2.0, release/O3, patched SDL prefix and pinned recording prefix identified in binary/runtime provenance. Native three-target build command and dependency identities are retained. Broad invocation:

```sh
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/glob2-terrain-sdl-patched/prefix/lib:/tmp/glob2-sdl3/prefix/lib \
TMPDIR="$PWD/artifacts/resource-refactor/test-tmp" \
python3 test/run_tests.py --binary all --no-display --exclude-tag benchmark -j2 \
  --junit artifacts/resource-refactor/native-da80-all.xml \
  --write-inventory artifacts/resource-refactor/native-da80-all-inventory.json \
  --artifacts artifacts/resource-refactor/native-da80-all-artifacts
```

Performance used eight alternating pairs, one discarded fresh-process warmup pair and zero in-process warmup, CPU affinity 0–7, the aligned fixed-window manifest, and no concurrent project builds/simulations/profiling. Exact runner arguments and before/after hashes are in `performance-4ca-legacy/metadata.json` and `input-verification.json`. Process-scoped profiles collected afterward are diagnostic only; no global host settings changed.

[Summary and limitations](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/04700262ddc3f16cb937890ac0626ef9faad028e/native-4ca-summary.json), [broad artifacts](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/04700262ddc3f16cb937890ac0626ef9faad028e/native-4ca-broad.zip), [focused/display artifacts](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/04700262ddc3f16cb937890ac0626ef9faad028e/native-4ca-focused-display.zip), [performance/diagnostic artifacts](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/04700262ddc3f16cb937890ac0626ef9faad028e/native-4ca-performance-diagnostics.zip). Every archive member was decompressed and verified against its retained SHA256 inventory. Executables/dependencies are not bundled.

Remaining: final platform refresh, final candidate tournament, eight-team/component stress, successful full CPU acceptance and gameplay review. macOS/iOS and physical ARM remain unverified. Earlier platform evidence is historical for the subsequent AI/query changes.

Archive inventories verify every decompressed member; source/base revisions, frozen binary hash, commands and input audits are included.

The campaign stopped after 16 complete scenarios with unchanged inputs; partial next-case rows remain. No aggregate acceptance is claimed. Hosted platform refresh is still in progress at 7be0b1f9f; final tournament, CPU corpus/stress and gameplay review remain outstanding. PR remains draft.

Platform formatting/type-import repairs, regenerated schemas, metadata-preserving map/save validation, and migrated menu harness are included, with their successful focused tests and earlier failures retained.

Two independently reviewed pass-local query caches preserve the recorded 8,192-tick comparisons. The final Cortex hard-space cache reduces instruction count 11.22% against09b under the exact benchmark command; this is diagnostic evidence, not CPU acceptance.

CPU acceptance remains open. All09b priority rows are included: Maxima failed and Cortex was inconclusive. A fresh user-authorized performance-governor block is prepared with independently reviewed restoration handling; it has not launched because unrelated host work is active. Original settings remain restored. The final42-run candidate gameplay campaign is now running separately, with no timing claim.

The PR remains draft. Final full-corpus CPU gates, gameplay comparison, and refreshed cross-platform checksum coverage are still outstanding.

Final-candidate Android simulation coverage is now complete for `b3fab1a48a9ac6ec74a6985e60a839eea54da346`: **36unit cases and98 focused engine cases passed**, with no source/payload drift. Stock, official-match and150-row custom-resource composition traces match native exactly. [Commands, inventories, build/compiler provenance, logs, traces and cleanup evidence](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/78dd865/android-b3fab-checkpoint).

This covers x86-64 native shell execution in the API35 emulator. It does not establish physical ARM execution, APK UI/lifecycle coverage, or performance. The owned emulator andADB server were stopped and their ports verified closed. Hosted Windows/macOS/browser final-revision checks and the separate performance/gameplay gates remain pending.

Merged as 9084ea907a004ec9a2315598256e1631793c00bf. Final accessible validation evidence is published: [42 candidate tournament logs, comparisons, and provenance](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/f42fd9e/final-tournament-b3fab) and [CLI repairs, generator checks, and telemetry epoch classification](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/f42fd9e/final-cli-repairs). Performance acceptance gates were explicitly waived by the maintainer and remain post-merge follow-up; this does not claim performance equivalence.
